messages:
marta-cs: FYI — Acme Ops flagged invoice INV-2023-9001. Their AP rejects it because the PO on the PDF/CSV is wrong (truncated). They attached a screenshot showing PO 'ACME-2023-INV-900' instead of 'ACME-2023-INV-9001'. Can we reissue?

invoice-bot: Invoice metadata: `invoice_id: INV-2023-9001, customer: Acme Corp, amount: $12,450.00, status: paid, payment_method: card, paid_at: 2024-11-02T14:23:11Z, po_number: ACME-2023-INV-900`

anya-support: Is the payment marked as settled? if it's unpaid we can just edit and reissue; if paid we'll need credit + reissue, correct?

marta-cs: It's paid. Charge ID CH_8f3a2... Customer says their AP will not accept the invoice without the right PO string (internal compliance). They need the corrected invoice for their ledger.

ella-finance: Right — standard workflow when an invoice is already paid and the customer requires a corrected invoice: full credit (credit memo) for INV-2023-9001, create a new invoice with corrected PO, then reapply the existing payment to the new invoice (or record a payment reallocation/journal). We'll need a journal entry to reverse AR and then re-apply.

raj-billing: I can take the billing ops steps. Requesting: (1) official approval note from finance (ella) to create credit memo; (2) confirmation that reapplying payment is OK and who will perform ledger reallocation; (3) the exact PO string to put on the new invoice.

marta-cs: Confirmed PO string from Acme: `ACME-2023-INV-9001` (no spaces). They want the PDF and exported CSV to contain the full PO. 

lucas-eng: Quick note from export side — looks like the CSV export truncates the PO to 30 chars in the nightly export job. Example from the export row: 
```
"invoice_id","po_number","amount"
"INV-2023-9001","ACME-2023-INV-900","12450.00"
```
The PDF generator currently consumes the CSV export for the invoice metadata in this code path; that's why the PDF shows truncated value.

lucas-eng: I'll open a bug and schedule a backfill to regenerate PDFs for affected invoices. For this ticket we can do a manual PDF regen and new invoice issuance from the admin UI.

ella-finance: Approve credit memo + reissue. Finance will perform the AR reversal journal once billing creates the credit memo. Raj, after you create the new invoice, ping accounting so we can reapply payment and mark reconciled.

raj-billing: On it. Steps I'll perform: 
1) Create credit memo for INV-2023-9001 (reason: PO mismatch / customer request).
2) Create new invoice INV-2023-9001-R1 with identical line items and correct PO `ACME-2023-INV-9001`.
3) Mark new invoice as issued.
4) Request accounting to move payment CH_8f3a2... from old invoice to new invoice.

marta-cs: Please draft the message I should send to Acme Ops once we do this. They want wording that confirms no change to net charged amount and that the corrected invoice will be in their system within 48 hours.

anya-support: Suggested customer note: 
"Thanks — we found that our export pipeline truncated your PO on the previous invoice. We will issue a credit for INV-2023-9001 and reissue an identical invoice with the corrected PO `ACME-2023-INV-9001`. Your payment will be reallocated to the corrected invoice; there will be no change to the amount charged. Expect the corrected invoice and reconciliation confirmation within 48 hours. Apologies for the inconvenience"

marta-cs: Copying that. I'll send it now.

raj-billing: Done: credit memo created (CM-2023-102) and new invoice created INV-2023-9001-R1. New invoice shows correct PO in admin UI. Waiting on accounting to reallocate payment.

ella-finance: Received. I'll do the AR reversal and reapply the payment this afternoon. Ledger entries: reverse AR INV-2023-9001, create AR for INV-2023-9001-R1, apply payment CH_8f3a2... to the new AR.

lucas-eng: Filed bug ENGR-4521 to stop truncation in nightly export and to run a backfill for PDF regeneration (impact estimated: 27 invoices). Will prioritize hotfix for the export schema.

marta-cs: Acme replied: "Thanks — confirm when done and please attach the corrected PDF and the updated CSV row so our AP can auto-ingest."

raj-billing: After accounting confirms reallocation I'll attach regenerated PDF and the corrected CSV row: 
```
"INV-2023-9001-R1","ACME-2023-INV-9001","12450.00"
```

ella-finance: Reallocation complete and reconciled. CH_8f3a2... now applied to INV-2023-9001-R1. Finance notes: no tax/VAT impact, amounts unchanged.

marta-cs: Sent to customer with attachments — they acknowledged receipt and said "This works, thanks" :thumbsup:.

lucas-eng: Leaving notes for backfill. Will follow up in ENGR-4521 with completion ETA.

anya-support: Marking this thread resolved for support. If anything else pops up from Acme, re-open or @support.

marta-cs: Thanks all — closing.
